image_description: A low-angle shot of a street sign assembly against a clear blue sky. The assembly consists of two rectangular black street name signs mounted on top of a circular white regulatory sign with a black border and a large black arrow symbol pointing right. The signs are mounted on a dark vertical post. Some tree tops are visible at the very bottom.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the upper rectangular signs is severely distorted, warped, and illegible. It resembles alien script or melted characters rather than standardized English typography, indicating a significant AI generation failure in rendering text.

The brackets holding the rectangular signs appear slightly fused with the post and the signs themselves. The geometry of the clamps is vague and lacks precise mechanical definition, suggesting minor structural ambiguity.

The black arrow inside the circle has slightly uneven thickness and soft, bleeding edges that do not perfectly align with the crispness expected of a printed regulatory sign, showing slight perspective warping.
